title: Young Boy Riding Tricycle, 1968 Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A candid late-1960s black-and-white square snapshot featuring a young boy, Jimmy, happily riding a pedal-powered tricycle across a grass lawn. In the soft-focus background, another individual (Arlee) relaxes in a folding lawn chair near additional ride-on toys, capturing a slice of suburban American childhood during August 1968.
